rationale: This function merely consumes a tracked OpenInvariantCredit (a linear/ghost resource) via a proof block and has no observable runtime effect. The linearity and consumption are enforced by the type system and ghost/proof machinery, so there is no non‑vacuous, meaningful public postcondition expressible in the existing vstd spec vocabulary.
risks: Lack of an explicit postcondition means the intent (consumption of the tracked credit) is not documented in a ensures clause; however, the type and proof ensure correctness.
If future changes introduce observable effects tied to this operation, a proper contract will be needed then.
